element.name: List the open questions
element.instructions:
Go through {{task}} and collect everything that someone has to decide and that you should not decide yourself: choices between two reasonable ways, things the request does not say, anything that would be expensive to undo.

One line per question, phrased so that it can be answered with a few words. Where it helps, add in the detail what you would do if nobody answers.
element.doneWhen: Every decision that is not yours to make is on the list, one per item.
